content: Tutra n Suliman - Aḍhar amezwaru n SIDI i Suliman
Suliman, mmis n Dawud, ittwaḍmen di tgelda nnes, minzi SIDI, AREBBI nnes, tuɣa-t akides uca yarni di řemɣaret nnes ař ṭṭarf.
Suliman issiweř ak-d marra Israil, ak-d imeqqranen x wařef u x mya, ak-d řquḍat u ak-d marra řḥukkam n marra Israil, izeǧifen x ibabaten n řaǧat.
Nitni ṭṭfen abrid, Suliman d marra agraw n řgens akides, ɣar řgeɛɛdet nni iǧan ɣar Jibɛun, minzi dinni i tuɣa Aqiḍun n Umsagar n AREBBI i igga Musa, amsexxar n SIDI, di řexřa.
Maca Dawud yiwi Ttabut n AREBBI zi Qaryat-Yaɛarim ɣar wemcan i dd as issewjed Dawud, minzi netta iwta ijj n uqiḍun i Ttabut di Urcalim.
Aɛalṭar n nnḥas nni igga Baṣaliyil, mmis n Uri, mmis n Ḥur, tuɣa din di Jibɛun zzat i Uqiḍun n Umsagar n SIDI. Suliman yuyur din jmiɛ ak-d marra agraw n řgens
uca iqeddem din Suliman, zzat i wudem n SIDI, ict n tɣarṣt x uɛalṭar n nnḥas nni iǧan ɣar Uqiḍun n Umsagar. Netta iqeddem xas ařef n tɣarṣa n wecmaḍ.
Di ǧiřet nni, iban-dd AREBBI i Suliman, inna as: “Ttar min texsed ad ac t wceɣ!”
Suliman inna i AREBBI: “Cek tessecned i baba Dawud tamexsiwt nnec icewwaren u teggid ayi d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
Xenni řexxu, a SIDI AREBBI, ejj ad iffeɣ wawař nnec i tessiwřed ak-d baba Dawud s tidett, minzi teggid ayi d ajeǧid x ijj n řgens iwseɛ am tɛejjajt n temmurt.
Ewc ayi řexxu tiɣit d tussna, ḥima ad ffɣeɣ u ad dd-dewřeɣ zzat i wudem n řgens-a am řḥakem nsen, minzi wi izemmaren ad iḥkem x řgens-a ameqqran s řḥeqq?”

Xenni inna AREBBI i Suliman: “Minzi aya ɣarek deg wuř u minzi cek war tᵉttared agřa, řeksibet niɣ ccan niɣ tudart n yinni i cek icarrhen, u war tᵉttared tudart tazirart, maca minzi tᵉttared tiɣit d tussna ḥima ad tgewwded řgens inu s řḥeqq, i wenni umi xef ggiɣ cek d ajeǧid,
aqa temmewc ac řexxu tiɣit d tussna, u ad ac wceɣ ɛawed agřa d řeksibet d ccan am mammec war ten iṭṭif uřa d ijj n ujeǧid qbeř nnec u war ten ttᵉṭṭifen ɛad ammu awarni ac.
Afeyyeḍ n wagřa n Suliman
Zi řgeɛɛdet i x ttnuman ttwehhben tiɣarṣa, řgeɛɛdet nni iǧan di Jibɛun arendad n Uqiḍun n Umsagar, yiweḍ-dd Suliman ɣar Urcalim uca iḥkem x Israil.
Suliman issmun ikarruten d imnayen. Netta tuɣa ɣares ařef u-arebɛa-mya n ikarruten d tenɛac-ařef n imnayen uca yiwyi ten ɣar tneddam n ikarruten u ɣar ujeǧid di Urcalim.
Ajeǧid igga nnuqart di Urcalim anect n yeẓra nni tuɣa din iǧan uca igga ticejjura n tengelt anect izemmuren nni tuɣa din iǧan di Temmurt Iwaṭan s waṭṭas.
Iwyen-dd iysan i Suliman zi Miṣra, zi Qiwi. Isebbaben n ujeǧid iwyen ten s yijj n ttaman imetnen zi Qiwi.

Iwyen-dd ijj n ukarru uca ssuffɣen t-i-dd zi Miṣra s ijj n ttaman n setta-mya ciqlu n nnuqart u ijj n uyis s mya u-xemsin ciqlu. Ammu i ssuffɣen ten s ufus nsen i marra ijeǧiden n Iḥittiyyen u i ijeǧiden n Aram.
Suliman yumur, ḥima ad tᵉttwabna ict n Taddart i Yisem n SIDI d ict n taddart i tgelda nnes.
